target.label: Pad to
target.desc: The image is never resampled: its pixels are copied 1:1 onto a larger canvas.

width.label: Width
width.desc: Canvas width. Images wider than this cannot be padded.

height.label: Height
height.desc: Canvas height. Images taller than this cannot be padded.

minSize.label: Minimum size
minSize.desc: Each side is at least this many pixels before rounding up to a power of two. 0 = none.

maxSize.label: Maximum size
maxSize.desc: Images that would need a larger canvas are reported as errors. 0 = unlimited.

anchor.label: Anchor
anchor.desc: Where the original image sits on the new canvas.

fill.label: Fill
fill.desc: Edge extend repeats the border pixels outward, which avoids seams with texture filtering and mipmaps.
